name: Dragonstorm
disable: The dragonstorm can't be disabled-only endured. It ends only once the attack on Breachill and Citadel Altaerein is over.

items.name: Localized Dragonstorm
items.text:
Trigger A new wave begins

---

Effect Roll 1d10 to determine which effect manifests from the following possibilities. The placement of these effects is guided by Dahak's will, and they should manifest in the most detrimental locations possible to the PCs.

items.name: 1-2 Acid Rain
items.text: A torrent of acid drenches creatures in a 20-foot burst. Creatures in the area take 6d10 acid damage (DC 42 basic Reflex save save). Creatures that critically fail also take 5 persistent,acid damage.

items.name: 3-4 Freezing Wind
items.text: A barrage of freezing wind and hail assaults all creatures in a 20-foot burst. Creatures in the area take 3d10 cold,3d10 bludgeoning damage (DC 42 basic Reflex save save). Creatures that critically fail are Slowed 1 for 1 round.

items.name: 5-6 Bolts of Lightning
items.text: Several bolts of lightning strike all creatures in a 20-foot burst. Creatures in the area take 6d10 electricity damage (DC 42 basic Reflex save save). Creatures that critically fail their saves become Blinded and Deafened for 1 round.

items.name: 7-8 Flaming Vortex
items.text: Gouts of flame fall on all creatures in a 20-foot burst. Creatures in the area take 6d10 fire damage (DC 42 basic Reflex save save). Creatures that critically fail their saves also take 5 persistent,fire damage.

items.name: 9-10 Poison Miasma
items.text: Poisonous mist rolls forth, covering a 20-foot burst for 1 round. Creatures within the mist become Concealed, and creatures outside it become concealed to creatures within it. Creatures within the mist take 6d10 poison damage (DC 42 basic Fortitude save save). Creatures that critically fail their saves become Enfeebled 2.

text: A massive storm stirs in the skies above Breachill and Citadel Altaerein. As specific events begin during the three waves of the manifestation's retribution, the dragonstorm wreaks localized havoc.
